name: Two-way weighted kNN
kind: Unsupervised weighted k-nearest-neighbour on 100 m relief (free text)
trained_on: Copernicus GLO-30 + ESA WorldCover (Earth) vs LOLA LDEM_80S_20M (Moon); 59 sites, 30 km each
inputs: 5 km relief squares, mission weights; no absolute elevation
limits: Sparse: scores ~59 of 78,993 cells. Unscored cells are 'not analysed', never 0.
